answer: Each identity must hold a unique proof-of-replica. Registration assigns an address-seeded 4 GB dataset to store and prove weekly: the replica is the garden, the burn at registration the onyx fee, the proof window the terrace. Bytes derive from the address, so replicas cannot be deduplicated; N puppets means N disks and N burns, linear cost, no bulk discount. Skip one terrace proof and the garden is voided, burn never refunded. Datasets are minted only at registration, so pre-farming fails and each fake identity pays fresh hardware plus burn every round.
